analysis.rationale: All 3 supports show one dominant deterministic global darkening: mean_shift -45.3/-66.7/-74.4, clipped_fraction 0.669/0.264/0.137, variance_ratio 0.193/0.709/0.830. Primary pair0: brightness_darken_shfit_HSV:4 gives PSNR 34.58 dB (30-40 -> UNCERTAIN) with signal-mode MATCH on mean_shift + variance_ratio; severity sweep on pair0 sev3=25.66, sev4=34.58, sev5=28.40 peaks at 4. No noise (sigma_prior 0.6-1.5 << noise_gaussian sev1), no JPEG (block_boundary 0.997-0.999; adding jpeg worsened CI/zeros), no supported blur (spectral_slope_ratio 0.93/1.01/1.09, anisotropy 0; glass/gaussian additions did not raise PSNR), separate saturate_weaken rejected (PSNR 34.58->33.00). Cross-pair PSNR (pair1 22.32, pair2 20.48) is low and pair1 variance_ratio favors the RGB-shift family -> supports do not share one exact fitting parameter set (per-pair severity or unmodeled tone-curve component); hence UNCERTAIN. Budget: 24 test_candidate calls over 3 rounds.
